rationale: Revised plan addresses the two critical parameter errors identified in evaluation. Denial rate denominator changed from all_claims to adjudicated_claims to exclude pending claims and correctly compute the denial rate with statistical discipline. Monthly trend date_column changed from adjudication_date to service_date_from to key the volume trend on when care began, avoiding adjudication date lag. All other components and parameters retained as they performed correctly. Synthetic data caveat maintained per retrieved skill.
changes_summary: Fixed two critical parameters: (1) denial_rate denominator changed from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to exclude pending claims per feedback T2-denial_rate_denominator; (2) monthly_trend date_column changed from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to use care start dates per feedback T2-monthly_date_column.
